title: Vapor: PHP 8.0 Runtime Is Now Available
content: <html><head></head><body>As you may know, Vapor allows you to specify which PHP version a given environment runs on. Of course, we want you to be able to use the latest PHP features as soon as possible. Beginning today, you may now specify "php-8.0" as your application's runtime.</body></html>
author: Nuno Maduro
